Keep this file secret-free; it lives in the PUBLIC dotfiles repo. NON-ANTHROPIC BACKENDS: the parked x-env Ollama profile that used to live here was retired on 2026-08-01, replaced by the per-process launchers in bin/ (claude-glm, claude-gpt, claude-ollama, claude-openrouter, all thin wrappers over bin/claude-run).
